description: Known weakness x new delivery channel. A weakness that is already known, and a channel the fix could travel through that nobody has tried for it. Neither proposal is good on its own; paired, the channel carries the weakness fix.
problem: Messages must reach users reliably even when a service is degraded.

known weakness: Retries amplify load during an outage
Cached reads go stale after a write
new delivery channel: Queued delivery that drains when a service recovers
